item.$description: Items of lists the user browses and picks from: menu items, listbox options, tabs, pages of a pagination, toolbar toggles. default sits on the surface that holds the list (transparent); selected marks the current choice; indicator paints the active mark (tab bar, check). Decided on 2026-10-31 (decisions.md, Overlays, composition and shared code).

elevation.$description: Separation of raised and floating surfaces in addition to their shadow: invisible in light, a thin contour in dark where shadows carry little (decided on 2026-10-31, approval pending the visual review).
